title_en: Food Safety Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en: Article 1 This Law is formulated to ensure food safety and safeguard public health and life safety.

Article 3 Food safety work shall be based on the principles of prevention first, risk management, whole-process control, and social co-governance, and a scientific and rigorous supervision and management system shall be established.

Article 4 Food producers and traders shall be responsible for the safety of the food they produce and trade.
Food producers and traders shall carry out production and trading activities in accordance with laws, regulations, and food safety standards, ensure food safety, act with integrity and self-discipline, be responsible to society and the public, accept social supervision, and bear social responsibility.

Article 5 The State Council shall establish a Food Safety Commission, whose duties shall be prescribed by the State Council.
The food safety supervision and administration department of the State Council shall, in accordance with this Law and the duties prescribed by the State Council, exercise supervision and administration over food production and trading activities.
The health administration department of the State Council shall, in accordance with this Law and the duties prescribed by the State Council, organize and carry out food safety risk monitoring and risk assessment, and jointly with the food safety supervision and administration department of the State Council formulate and publish national food safety standards.
Other relevant departments of the State Council shall, in accordance with this Law and the duties prescribed by the State Council, undertake relevant food safety work.

Article 6 Local people's governments at or above the county level shall be responsible for the supervision and administration of food safety within their respective administrative regions, shall lead, organize, and coordinate the supervision and administration of food safety and the response to food safety emergencies within their administrative regions, and shall establish a sound mechanism for the whole-process supervision and administration of food safety and a mechanism for information sharing.
Local people's governments at or above the county level shall, in accordance with this Law and the provisions of the State Council, determine the duties of the food safety supervision and administration department, the health administration department, and other relevant departments at the same level. The relevant departments shall be responsible for the supervision and administration of food safety within their respective administrative regions within the scope of their respective duties.
The food safety supervision and administration department of a county-level people's government may establish dispatched agencies in townships or specific areas.

Article 7 Local people's governments at or above the county level shall implement a responsibility system for the supervision and administration of food safety. The people's government at a higher level shall be responsible for evaluating and assessing the food safety supervision and administration work of the people's government at the next lower level. Local people's governments at or above the county level shall be responsible for evaluating and assessing the food safety supervision and administration work of the food safety supervision and administration department and other relevant departments at the same level.

Article 8 People's governments at or above the county level shall incorporate food safety work into the national economic and social development plan at the same level, include food safety work funds in the fiscal budget of the people's government at the same level, strengthen the capacity building for food safety supervision and administration, and provide guarantee for food safety work.
The food safety supervision and administration department and other relevant departments of people's governments at or above the county level shall strengthen communication, cooperate closely, exercise their powers according to law and assume responsibilities in accordance with their respective duties.

Article 9 Food industry associations shall strengthen self-discipline, establish and improve industry norms and reward and punishment mechanisms in accordance with their articles of association, provide food safety information, technology and other services, guide and urge food producers and traders to produce and trade according to law, promote the building of industry integrity, and publicize and popularize food safety knowledge.
Consumers' associations and other consumer organizations shall, in accordance with law, exercise social supervision over acts that violate the provisions of this Law and harm the legitimate rights and interests of consumers.

Article 10 People's governments at all levels shall strengthen the publicity and education on food safety, popularize food safety knowledge, encourage social organizations, grassroots self-governing mass organizations, and food producers and traders to carry out the popularization of laws, regulations, food safety standards, and knowledge on food safety, advocate healthy dietary habits, and enhance consumers' food safety awareness and self-protection ability.
News media shall conduct public interest publicity on laws, regulations, food safety standards, and knowledge on food safety, and exercise public opinion supervision over illegal acts in food safety. Reports and publicity concerning food safety shall be truthful and fair.

Article 11 The State encourages and supports basic research and applied research related to food safety, and encourages and supports food producers and traders to adopt advanced technologies and advanced management norms for the purpose of improving food safety levels.
The State implements a strict management system for the use of pesticides, accelerates the elimination of highly toxic, highly toxic, and highly residual pesticides, promotes the research, development, and application of alternative products, and encourages the use of highly effective, low-toxicity, and low-residue pesticides.

Article 12 Any organization or individual shall have the right to report illegal acts in food safety, to obtain information on food safety from relevant departments according to law, and to put forward opinions and suggestions on food safety supervision and administration.
Article 13 Units and individuals that have made outstanding contributions to food safety work shall be commended and rewarded in accordance with relevant State regulations.

Article 14 The State establishes a food safety risk monitoring system to monitor foodborne diseases, food contamination, and harmful factors in food.
The health administration department of the State Council shall, jointly with the food safety supervision and administration department of the State Council and other relevant departments, formulate and implement a national food safety risk monitoring plan.
After obtaining information on food safety risks, the food safety supervision and administration department of the State Council and other relevant departments shall promptly verify it and notify the health administration department of the State Council. With respect to information on food safety risks notified by relevant departments and information on foodborne diseases and other related diseases reported by medical institutions, the health administration department of the State Council shall, jointly with the relevant departments of the State Council, analyze and study it, and if deemed necessary, promptly adjust the national food safety risk monitoring plan.
The health administration departments of the people's governments of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government shall, jointly with the food safety supervision and administration departments at the same level, formulate and adjust a food safety risk monitoring plan for their respective administrative regions based on the national food safety risk monitoring plan and in light of the specific circumstances of their administrative regions, and report it to the health administration department of the State Council for record and implementation.

Article 15 Technical institutions undertaking food safety risk monitoring work shall carry out monitoring work in accordance with the food safety risk monitoring plan and monitoring plan, ensure that monitoring data are true and accurate, and submit monitoring data and analysis results in accordance with the requirements of the food safety risk monitoring plan and monitoring plan.
Personnel engaged in food safety risk monitoring shall have the right to enter the relevant edible agricultural product planting and breeding sites and food production and trading premises to collect samples and collect relevant data. Fees for sample collection shall be paid according to market prices.

Article 16 Where the results of food safety risk monitoring indicate that there may be potential food safety risks, the health administration department of the people's government at or above the county level shall promptly notify the food safety supervision and administration department and other relevant departments at the same level of the relevant information, and report to the people's government at the same level and the health administration department of the people's government at a higher level. The food safety supervision and administration department and other relevant departments shall organize further investigations.

Article 17 The State establishes a food safety risk assessment system, using scientific methods to conduct risk assessment of biological, chemical, and physical hazard factors in food, food additives, and food-related products based on food safety risk monitoring information, scientific data, and relevant information.
The health administration department of the State Council shall be responsible for organizing food safety risk assessment work, and shall establish a food safety risk assessment expert committee composed of experts in fields such as medicine, agriculture, food, nutrition, biology, and environment to conduct food safety risk assessment. The results of food safety risk assessment shall be published by the health administration department of the State Council.
Experts from the food safety risk assessment expert committee shall participate in the safety assessment of pesticides, fertilizers, veterinary drugs, feed, and feed additives.
No fees shall be charged to producers and traders for food safety risk assessment, and fees for sample collection shall be paid according to market prices.

Article 19 Where the food safety supervision and administration department of the State Council, the agricultural administration department, and other relevant departments find that a food safety risk assessment is needed in the course of supervision and administration, they shall make a recommendation for food safety risk assessment to the health administration department of the State Council, and provide information and materials such as risk sources, relevant inspection data, and conclusions. In circumstances falling under Article 18 of this Law, the health administration department of the State Council shall promptly conduct a food safety risk assessment and notify the relevant departments of the State Council of the assessment results.

Article 20 The health administration departments and agricultural administration departments of people's governments at or above the provincial level shall promptly notify each other of information on food and edible agricultural product safety risk monitoring.
The health administration department and agricultural administration department of the State Council shall promptly notify each other of information on food and edible agricultural product safety risk assessment results and other relevant information.

Article 21 The result of food safety risk assessment shall be the scientific basis for developing, revising food safety standards and for implementing food safety supervision and administration.
Where, through food safety risk assessment, a conclusion is reached that a food, food additive, or food-related product is unsafe, the food safety supervision and administration department of the State Council and other relevant departments shall, according to their respective functions, immediately announce to the public, inform consumers to stop consuming or using, and take corresponding measures to ensure the suspension of production and business operations of such food, food additive, or food-related product; where it is necessary to develop or revise relevant national food safety standards, the health administrative department of the State Council shall, jointly with the food safety supervision and administration department of the State Council, immediately develop or revise them.

Article 22 The food safety supervision and administration department of the State Council shall, jointly with the relevant departments of the State Council, conduct comprehensive analysis on the food safety situation based on the results of food safety risk assessment and food safety supervision and administration information. For food that, through comprehensive analysis, is shown to have a relatively high degree of safety risk, the food safety supervision and administration department of the State Council shall promptly issue a food safety risk warning and announce it to the public.

Article 23 The food safety supervision and administration department of the people's government at or above the county level and other relevant departments, the food safety risk assessment expert committee and its technical institutions shall, in accordance with the principles of being scientific, objective, timely, and open, organize food producers and traders, food inspection institutions, certification bodies, food industry associations, consumer associations, and the news media, among others, to exchange and communicate on food safety risk assessment information and food safety supervision and administration information.
Article 24 The development of food safety standards shall aim at protecting public health and shall be scientific, reasonable, safe, and reliable.
Article 25 Food safety standards are compulsory enforcement standards. No other mandatory food standards shall be developed except for food safety standards.

Article 27 National food safety standards shall be developed and promulgated by the health administrative department of the State Council jointly with the food safety supervision and administration department of the State Council, and the standardization administrative department of the State Council shall provide the national standard number.
Limit provisions on pesticide residues and veterinary drug residues in food and the inspection methods and procedures thereof shall be developed by the health administrative department of the State Council and the agricultural administrative department of the State Council jointly with the food safety supervision and administration department of the State Council.
Inspection procedures for the slaughter of livestock and poultry shall be developed by the agricultural administrative department of the State Council jointly with the health administrative department of the State Council.

Article 28 In developing national food safety standards, the results of food safety risk assessment shall be relied upon, and the results of edible agricultural product safety risk assessment shall be fully taken into account, relevant international standards and international food safety risk assessment results shall be referred to, and the draft national food safety standards shall be published to the public to extensively solicit opinions from food producers and traders, consumers, relevant departments, and other parties.
National food safety standards shall be examined and approved by the National Food Safety Standard Review Committee organized by the health administrative department of the State Council. The National Food Safety Standard Review Committee shall be composed of experts in medicine, agriculture, food, nutrition, biology, environment, and other fields, as well as representatives from relevant departments of the State Council, food industry associations, and consumer associations, and shall examine the scientific nature and practicability of the draft national food safety standards.

Article 29 For local specialty foods for which there are no national food safety standards, the health administrative department of the people's government of a province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government may develop and promulgate local food safety standards, and shall report them to the health administrative department of the State Council for archival filing. After national food safety standards are developed, such local standards shall be abolished.

Article 30 The State encourages food production enterprises to develop enterprise standards that are more stringent than national food safety standards or local food safety standards, to be applied within the enterprise, and to report such standards to the health administrative department of the people's government of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government for archival filing.

Article 31 The health administrative department of the people's government at or above the provincial level shall publish on its website the national food safety standards, local food safety standards, and enterprise standards that have been developed and filed, for the public to consult and download free of charge.
For issues in the implementation of food safety standards, the health administrative department of the people's government at or above the county level shall, jointly with relevant departments, promptly provide guidance and answers.

Article 32 The health administrative department of the people's government at or above the provincial level shall, jointly with the food safety supervision and administration, agricultural administrative, and other departments at the same level, conduct follow-up evaluation on the implementation of national food safety standards and local food safety standards respectively, and shall promptly revise the food safety standards based on the evaluation results.
The food safety supervision and administration, agricultural administrative, and other departments of the people's government at or above the provincial level shall collect and summarize the problems existing in the implementation of food safety standards, and shall promptly report to the health administrative department at the same level.
Food producers and traders and food industry associations that discover problems in the implementation of food safety standards shall immediately report to the health administrative department.

Article 84 A food inspection institution may engage in food inspection activities only after obtaining qualification accreditation in accordance with the relevant provisions of the State on certification and accreditation, unless otherwise provided by law.
The qualification accreditation conditions and inspection specifications for food inspection institutions shall be prescribed by the food safety supervision and administration department of the State Council.
Inspection reports issued by food inspection institutions that comply with the provisions of this Law shall have equal validity.
People's governments at or above the county level shall integrate food inspection resources to achieve resource sharing.

Article 85 Food inspection shall be independently conducted by inspectors designated by the food inspection institution.
Inspectors shall inspect food in accordance with relevant laws and regulations and according to food safety standards and inspection specifications, respect science, abide by professional ethics, ensure that the inspection data and conclusions issued are objective and fair, and shall not issue false inspection reports.

Article 86 Food inspection shall implement a responsibility system for food inspection institutions and inspectors. The food inspection report shall be stamped with the official seal of the food inspection institution and signed or sealed by the inspector. The food inspection institution and the inspector shall be responsible for the food inspection report issued.

Article 87 The food safety supervision and administration department of the people's government at or above the county level shall conduct regular or irregular sampling inspections of food, and shall publish the inspection results according to relevant provisions, and no exemption from inspection shall be allowed. For sampling inspections, the samples drawn shall be purchased, and shall be entrusted to a food inspection institution that complies with the provisions of this Law for inspection, and the relevant expenses shall be paid; no inspection fees or other fees shall be collected from food producers or traders.

Article 88 Where a food producer or trader disagrees with the inspection conclusion implemented in accordance with the provisions of this Law, it may, within seven working days from receipt of the inspection conclusion, apply for re-inspection to the food safety supervision and administration department that conducted the sampling inspection or to its superior food safety supervision and administration department. The food safety supervision and administration department that accepts the re-inspection application shall randomly determine a re-inspection institution from the published list of re-inspection institutions to conduct the re-inspection. The re-inspection conclusion issued by the re-inspection institution shall be the final inspection conclusion. The re-inspection institution and the initial inspection institution shall not be the same institution. The list of re-inspection institutions shall be jointly published by the certification and accreditation supervision and administration, food safety supervision and administration, health administrative, and agricultural administrative departments of the State Council.
Where rapid testing methods prescribed by the State are used for spot-checking edible agricultural products, and the person subject to spot-checking disagrees with the test result, it may apply for re-inspection within four hours from receipt of the test result. Rapid testing methods shall not be used for re-inspection.

Article 89 A food production enterprise may conduct inspection on the food it produces on its own, or may entrust a food inspection institution that complies with the provisions of this Law to conduct inspection.
Where organizations such as food industry associations and consumer associations, or consumers need to entrust a food inspection institution to inspect food, they shall entrust a food inspection institution that complies with the provisions of this Law.
Article 90 The inspection of food additives shall be governed by the provisions of this Law on food inspection.
Article 91 The national entry-exit inspection and quarantine department shall conduct supervision and administration over the safety of import and export food.

Article 92 Imported food, food additives, and food-related products shall comply with the national food safety standards of China.
Imported food and food additives shall be inspected and certified as qualified by the entry-exit inspection and quarantine authorities in accordance with the provisions of relevant laws and administrative regulations on the inspection of import and export commodities.
Imported food and food additives shall be accompanied by certificates of conformity as required by the national entry-exit inspection and quarantine department.

Article 93 For imported food for which there is no national food safety standard, the overseas exporter, overseas manufacturer, or the importer authorized by them shall submit the relevant national (regional) or international standard implemented to the health administrative department of the State Council. The health administrative department of the State Council shall review the relevant standard and, if it deems the standard to meet the food safety requirements, decide to apply it provisionally and promptly formulate the corresponding national food safety standard. The import of food produced with new food raw materials or the import of new varieties of food additives or new varieties of food-related products shall be handled in accordance with the provisions of Article 37 of this Law.
The entry-exit inspection and quarantine authorities shall, as required by the health administrative department of the State Council, inspect the food, food additives, and food-related products specified in the preceding paragraph. The inspection results shall be made public.

Article 94 Overseas exporters and overseas manufacturers shall ensure that the food, food additives, and food-related products exported to China comply with the provisions of this Law and other relevant laws and administrative regulations of China as well as the requirements of the national food safety standards, and shall be responsible for the content of labels and instructions.
Importers shall establish an audit system for overseas exporters and overseas manufacturers, focusing on auditing the content specified in the preceding paragraph; if the audit is not passed, importation shall not be allowed.
If imported food is found to be non-compliant with the national food safety standards of China or if there is evidence that it may harm human health, the importer shall immediately stop importation and recall it in accordance with the provisions of Article 63 of this Law.

Article 95 Where a food safety incident occurring abroad may have an impact within China, or where serious food safety problems are discovered in imported food, food additives, or food-related products, the national entry-exit inspection and quarantine department shall promptly take risk warnings or control measures and notify the food safety supervision and administration department, the health administrative department, and the agricultural administrative department of the State Council. The department receiving the notification shall promptly take corresponding measures.
The food safety supervision and administration departments of the people's governments at or above the county level shall supervise and administer imported food and food additives sold on the domestic market. If serious food safety problems are discovered, the food safety supervision and administration department of the State Council shall promptly notify the national entry-exit inspection and quarantine department. The national entry-exit inspection and quarantine department shall promptly take corresponding measures.

Article 96 Overseas exporters or agents that export food to China and importers of imported food shall file records with the national entry-exit inspection and quarantine department. Overseas food manufacturers that export food to China shall be registered with the national entry-exit inspection and quarantine department. If a registered overseas food manufacturer provides false materials or, due to its own reasons, causes a major food safety incident in imported food, the national entry-exit inspection and quarantine department shall revoke the registration and make an announcement.
The national entry-exit inspection and quarantine department shall periodically publish the list of overseas exporters, agents, and importers that have filed records and the list of overseas food manufacturers that have been registered.

Article 97 Imported prepackaged food and food additives shall have Chinese labels; if instructions are required by law, there shall also be Chinese instructions. The labels and instructions shall comply with the provisions of this Law and other relevant laws and administrative regulations of China as well as the requirements of the national food safety standards, and shall indicate the country of origin of the food and the name, address, and contact information of the domestic agent. Prepackaged food without Chinese labels or Chinese instructions, or whose labels or instructions do not comply with the provisions of this Article, shall not be imported.

Article 98 Importers shall establish a record system for the import and sale of food and food additives, truthfully recording the name, specifications, quantity, date of production, production or import batch number, shelf life, name and address and contact information of the overseas exporter and buyer, date of delivery, and other content, and shall keep relevant vouchers. The retention period of records and vouchers shall comply with the provisions of paragraph 2 of Article 50 of this Law.

Article 99 Food manufacturers exporting food shall ensure that their exported food meets the standards or contractual requirements of the importing country (region).
Food manufacturers exporting food and the planting and breeding farms of raw materials for exported food shall file records with the national entry-exit inspection and quarantine department.

Article 101 The national entry-exit inspection and quarantine department may evaluate and review the food safety management system and food safety status of countries (regions) that export food to China, and determine the corresponding inspection and quarantine requirements based on the evaluation and review results.

Article 102 The State Council shall organize the formulation of the national contingency plan for food safety incidents.
Local people's governments at or above the county level shall formulate contingency plans for food safety incidents within their respective administrative regions based on the provisions of relevant laws and regulations, the contingency plan of the people's government at the next higher level for food safety incidents, and the actual conditions of their administrative regions, and shall report them to the people's government at the next higher level for recordation.
The contingency plan for food safety incidents shall stipulate the classification of food safety incidents, the organization, command system, and responsibilities for incident handling, prevention and early warning mechanisms, handling procedures, emergency safeguard measures, and other matters.
Food production and business operators shall develop plans for handling food safety incidents, regularly inspect the implementation of various food safety preventive measures within their enterprises, and promptly eliminate accident risks.

Article 103 The unit where a food safety incident occurs shall immediately take measures to prevent the expansion of the incident. The unit where the incident occurs and the unit that receives patients for treatment shall promptly report to the food safety supervision and administration department and the health administrative department of the people's government at the county level of the place where the incident occurs.
If the agricultural administrative department of a people's government at or above the county level discovers a food safety incident in the course of routine supervision and administration or receives a report of an incident, it shall promptly notify the food safety supervision and administration department at the same level.
Upon the occurrence of a food safety incident, the food safety supervision and administration department of the people's government at the county level that receives the report shall report to the people's government at the same level and the food safety supervision and administration department of the people's government at the next higher level in accordance with the provisions of the contingency plan. The people's government at the county level and the food safety supervision and administration department of the people's government at the next higher level shall report upward in accordance with the provisions of the contingency plan.
No unit or individual shall conceal, make false reports, or delay reports on a food safety incident, or conceal, forge, or destroy relevant evidence.

Article 104 If a medical institution discovers that a patient it has received is a patient with a foodborne disease or a suspected patient, it shall promptly report the relevant information to the health administrative department of the people's government at the county level of the place where it is located in accordance with the provisions. If the health administrative department of the people's government at the county level deems that the matter is related to food safety, it shall promptly notify the food safety supervision and administration department at the same level.
If a health administrative department of a people's government at or above the county level discovers information related to food safety during the investigation and handling of infectious diseases or other public health emergencies, it shall promptly notify the food safety supervision and administration department at the same level.

Article 106 When a food safety incident occurs, the food safety supervision and administration department of the people's government at or above the city with districts shall immediately, jointly with the relevant departments, conduct an investigation into the responsibility for the incident, urge the relevant departments to fulfill their duties, and submit a report on the investigation and handling of the incident responsibility to the people's government at the same level and the food safety supervision and administration department of the people's government at the next higher level.
For a major food safety incident involving two or more provinces, autonomous regions, or municipalities directly under the Central Government, the food safety supervision and administration department of the State Council shall organize an investigation into the incident responsibility in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.

Article 107 The investigation of a food safety incident shall adhere to the principles of seeking truth from facts and respecting science, and shall promptly and accurately ascertain the nature and cause of the incident, determine the responsibility for the incident, and propose corrective measures.
When investigating a food safety incident, in addition to ascertaining the responsibility of the unit where the incident occurred, the responsibility of the relevant supervision and administration departments, food inspection agencies, certification agencies, and their staff members shall also be ascertained.

Article 108 The department investigating a food safety incident shall have the authority to inquire of the relevant entities and individuals about the circumstances related to the incident and to require them to provide relevant materials and samples. The relevant entities and individuals shall cooperate and provide the relevant materials and samples as required, and shall not refuse.
No entity or individual may obstruct or interfere with the investigation and handling of a food safety incident.

Article 111 If the results of a food safety risk assessment prove that there is a potential safety hazard in food and that a food safety standard needs to be formulated or revised, before the formulation or revision of the food safety standard, the health administrative department of the State Council shall, jointly with the relevant departments of the State Council, promptly stipulate temporary limit values and temporary inspection methods for harmful substances in food, to serve as the basis for production, business operations, and supervision and administration.

Article 112 The food safety supervision and administration department of a people's government at or above the county level may, in the work of food safety supervision and administration, adopt the rapid testing methods prescribed by the State to carry out random testing of food.
Where the result of a random test indicates that the food may fail to meet the food safety standards, the food shall be tested in accordance with the provisions of Article 87 of this Law. Where the result of a random test confirms that the relevant food fails to meet the food safety standards, it may serve as the basis for an administrative penalty.

Article 113 The food safety supervision and administration department of a people's government at or above the county level shall establish food safety credit files for food producers and traders, recording the issuance of permits, results of routine supervision and inspection, and the investigation and punishment of illegal acts, and shall make them public according to law and update them in real time; it shall increase the frequency of supervision and inspection for food producers and traders with adverse credit records, and may notify the investment regulatory authority, the securities regulatory authority, and relevant financial institutions of food producers and traders whose illegal acts are of a serious nature.

Article 114 Where there is a potential food safety hazard during the process of food production and trading, and where measures are not taken in a timely manner to eliminate such hazard, the food safety supervision and administration department of a people's government at or above the county level may conduct a responsible interview with the legal representative or principal person in charge of the food producer or trader. The food producer or trader shall immediately take measures to rectify and eliminate the hazard. The situation of the responsible interview and the rectification shall be included in the food safety credit file of the food producer or trader.

Article 115 The food safety supervision and administration department and other relevant departments of a people's government at or above the county level shall publish their email addresses or telephone numbers to accept inquiries, complaints, and reports. Upon receiving an inquiry, complaint, or report, if the matter falls within their functions and duties, they shall accept it and promptly respond, verify, and handle it within the statutory time limit; if the matter does not fall within their functions and duties, they shall transfer it to the department with the authority to handle it and notify the inquirer, complainant, or reporter in writing. The department with the authority to handle it shall deal with the matter promptly within the statutory time limit and shall not shirk its responsibility. A reward shall be given to a reporter whose report is verified to be true.
The relevant departments shall keep the information of the reporter confidential and protect the lawful rights and interests of the reporter. Where a reporter reports against the enterprise where he or she works, such enterprise shall not take retaliatory actions against the reporter by rescinding or modifying the labor contract or by any other means.

Article 116 The food safety supervision and administration department and other relevant departments of a people's government at or above the county level shall strengthen the training of law enforcement personnel on food safety laws, regulations, standards, professional knowledge, and law enforcement capabilities, and shall organize assessments. Those who do not possess the corresponding knowledge and capabilities shall not engage in food safety law enforcement work.
Where food producers or traders, food industry associations, consumer associations, or others discover that food safety law enforcement personnel have violated laws or regulations or engaged in non-standard law enforcement during the enforcement process, they may file a complaint or report with the food safety supervision and administration department or other relevant departments at the same level or at the level of the people's government above, or with the supervisory authority. The department or authority receiving the complaint or report shall verify the matter, notify the department to which the food safety law enforcement personnel belong of the verified situation; and if the matter involves suspected violations of law or discipline, it shall be handled in accordance with this Law and relevant provisions.

Article 117 Where the food safety supervision and administration department of a people's government at or above the county level fails to promptly detect systemic food safety risks or fails to promptly eliminate potential food safety hazards within its supervision and administration area, the people's government at the same level may conduct a responsible interview with its principal person in charge.
Where a local people's government fails to perform its food safety duties and fails to promptly eliminate major regional food safety hazards, the people's government at the next higher level may conduct a responsible interview with its principal person in charge.
The food safety supervision and administration department or other relevant department, or the local people's government that has been interviewed shall immediately take measures to rectify its food safety supervision and administration work.
The situation of the responsible interview and the rectification shall be included in the evaluation and assessment records of the local people's government and relevant departments regarding food safety supervision and administration work.

Article 118 The State shall establish a unified food safety information platform and implement a system for the unified release of food safety information. The overall national food safety situation, food safety risk warning information, major food safety accidents and their investigation and handling information, and other information that the State Council determines shall be uniformly released shall be uniformly released by the food safety supervision and administration department of the State Council. Where the impact of food safety risk warning information and major food safety accidents and their investigation and handling information is limited to a specific region, such information may also be released by the food safety supervision and administration department of the relevant province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government. The above information shall not be released without authorization.
The food safety supervision and administration department and the agricultural administrative department of a people's government at or above the county level shall, in accordance with their respective functions and duties, release routine food safety supervision and administration information.
The release of food safety information shall be accurate and timely, with necessary explanations to avoid misleading consumers and public opinion.

Article 119 Where the food safety supervision and administration department, the health administrative department, or the agricultural administrative department of a local people's government at or above the county level becomes aware of information that is required to be uniformly released under this Law, it shall report to the competent department at the next higher level, and the competent department at the next higher level shall immediately report to the food safety supervision and administration department of the State Council; where necessary, it may directly report to the food safety supervision and administration department of the State Council.
The food safety supervision and administration department, the health administrative department, and the agricultural administrative department of a people's government at or above the county level shall inform each other of the food safety information they become aware of.

Article 120 No entity or individual shall fabricate or disseminate false food safety information.
Where the food safety supervision and administration department of a people's government at or above the county level discovers food safety information that may mislead consumers and public opinion, it shall immediately organize relevant departments, professional institutions, relevant food producers and traders, and others to verify and analyze such information, and promptly publish the results.

Article 121 Where the food safety supervision and administration department or other relevant department of a people's government at or above the county level discovers a suspected food safety crime, it shall promptly transfer the case to the public security organ in accordance with relevant provisions. The public security organ shall promptly review the transferred case; if it considers that there is a criminal fact and criminal liability shall be investigated, it shall file the case for investigation.
Where, during the investigation of a food safety criminal case, the public security organ considers that there is no criminal fact, or the criminal fact is obviously minor and does not warrant investigation of criminal liability, but administrative liability shall be investigated according to law, it shall promptly transfer the case to the food safety supervision and administration department or other relevant departments and the supervisory authority, and the relevant departments shall handle it according to law.
Where the public security organ requests assistance from the food safety supervision and administration department, the ecological environment department, or other relevant departments in providing test conclusions, appraisal opinions, or harmless treatment of the items involved in the case, the relevant departments shall promptly provide such assistance.

Article 122 Whoever, in violation of the provisions of this Law, engages in food production or business operation without obtaining a food production or business operation license, or engages in the production of food additives without obtaining a food additive production license, the food safety supervision and administration department of the people's government at or above the county level shall confiscate the illegal gains and the illegally produced or operated food and food additives, as well as the tools, equipment, raw materials and other articles used for the illegal production or business operation; if the value of the illegally produced or operated food and food additives is less than 10,000 yuan, a fine of not less than 50,000 yuan but not more than 100,000 yuan shall also be imposed; if the value is 10,000 yuan or more, a fine of not less than 10 times but not more than 20 times the value shall also be imposed.
Whoever knowingly provides premises or other conditions for the illegal act specified in the preceding paragraph shall be ordered by the food safety supervision and administration department of the people's government at or above the county level to cease the illegal act, have the illegal gains confiscated, and be imposed a fine of not less than 50,000 yuan but not more than 100,000 yuan; if the legitimate rights and interests of consumers are harmed, such person shall bear joint and several liability with the food or food additive producer or business operator.

Article 127 The punishment for illegal acts of small food production and processing workshops, food vendors, etc. shall be implemented in accordance with the specific management measures formulated by the provinces, autonomous regions, or municipalities directly under the Central Government.

Article 128 Where, in violation of the provisions of this Law, the responsible entity fails to handle or report a food safety accident after its occurrence, the relevant competent department shall, in accordance with their respective functions and duties, order correction and give a warning; if the entity conceals, forges, or destroys relevant evidence, it shall be ordered to suspend production or business operation, have its illegal gains confiscated, and be imposed a fine of not less than 100,000 yuan but not more than 500,000 yuan; if serious consequences are caused, its license shall be revoked.

Article 130 Where, in violation of the provisions of this Law, the sponsor of a centralized trading market, the lessor of a counter, or the organizer of an exhibition or sale allows a food business operator who has not obtained a license according to law to enter the market to sell food, or fails to perform the obligations of inspection, reporting, etc., the food safety supervision and administration department of the people's government at or above the county level shall order correction, confiscate the illegal gains, and impose a fine of not less than 50,000 yuan but not more than 200,000 yuan; if serious consequences are caused, the entity shall be ordered to suspend business until the original licensing authority revokes the license; if the legitimate rights and interests of consumers are harmed, the entity shall bear joint and several liability with the food business operator.
Where an edible agricultural product wholesale market violates the provisions of Article 64 of this Law, it shall bear liability in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.

Article 131 Where, in violation of the provisions of this Law, a third-party platform provider for online food trading fails to conduct real-name registration and examine the license of a food business operator on its platform, or fails to perform the obligations of reporting, suspending the provision of online trading platform services, etc., the food safety supervision and administration department of the people's government at or above the county level shall order correction, confiscate the illegal gains, and impose a fine of not less than 50,000 yuan but not more than 200,000 yuan; if serious consequences are caused, the entity shall be ordered to suspend business until the original licensing authority revokes the license; if the legitimate rights and interests of consumers are harmed, the entity shall bear joint and several liability with the food business operator.
Where a consumer purchases food through a third-party platform for online food trading and his or her legitimate rights and interests are harmed, the consumer may claim compensation from the food business operator on the platform or the food producer. If the third-party platform provider for online food trading fails to provide the true name, address and valid contact information of the food business operator on the platform, the third-party platform provider shall compensate. After compensation, the third-party platform provider shall have the right to seek recourse against the food business operator on the platform or the food producer. If a third-party platform provider for online food trading makes a commitment that is more favorable to consumers, it shall fulfill such commitment.

Article 132 In violation of the provisions of this Law, where food storage, transport, or loading and unloading are not carried out as required, the food safety supervision and administration department of the people's government at or above the county level, among other departments, shall, in accordance with their respective functions and duties, order corrective action and give a warning; if corrective action is refused, the department shall order suspension of production and business operation and impose a fine of not less than 10,000 yuan but not more than 50,000 yuan; if the circumstances are serious, the license shall be revoked.

In violation of the provisions of this Law, where a road transport operator fails to conduct bulk transport of key liquid food as required, the penalty shall be imposed in accordance with the preceding paragraph; if the circumstances are serious, in addition to revocation of the license, a fine of not less than 50,000 yuan but not more than 500,000 yuan shall be imposed.

In violation of the provisions of this Law, where a person engages in road bulk transport of key liquid food without obtaining a transport permit, the food safety supervision and administration department of the people's government at or above the county level shall order cessation of the road bulk transport business of key liquid food, confiscate illegal gains, and impose a fine of not less than 50,000 yuan but not more than 500,000 yuan.

In violation of the provisions of this Law, where a person forges, alters, or uses forged or altered documents such as records of road bulk transport of key liquid food or cleaning vouchers for transport containers, or fails to fulfill the relevant inspection and verification obligations related to road bulk transport of key liquid food, the food safety supervision and administration department of the people's government at or above the county level, among other departments, shall, in accordance with their respective functions and duties, order corrective action and give a warning; if corrective action is refused, a fine of not less than 10,000 yuan but not more than 100,000 yuan shall be imposed.

Article 133 In violation of the provisions of this Law, where a person refuses, obstructs, or interferes with the relevant departments, agencies, and their staff members carrying out food safety supervision and inspection, accident investigation and handling, risk monitoring, and risk assessment according to law, the relevant competent department shall, in accordance with its respective functions and duties, order suspension of production and business operation and impose a fine of not less than 2,000 yuan but not more than 50,000 yuan; if the circumstances are serious, the license shall be revoked; if the act constitutes a violation of public security administration, the public security organ shall impose a public security administration penalty according to law.

In violation of the provisions of this Law, where a person retaliates against a whistleblower by terminating or modifying the labor contract or by any other means, the person shall bear liability in accordance with the provisions of relevant laws.

Article 134 Where a food producer or trader, within one year, accumulates three times of being penalized with punishments other than order to suspend production and business operation or revocation of the license for violating the provisions of this Law, the food safety supervision and administration department shall order suspension of production and business operation, or even revoke the license.

Article 135 A food producer or trader whose license has been revoked, and its legal representative, directly responsible persons in charge, and other directly liable persons shall not apply for a food production or trading permit, or engage in food production or trading management, or serve as a food safety manager of a food production or trading enterprise within five years from the date of the penalty decision.

A person who has been sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment or a heavier penalty for a food safety crime shall be permanently prohibited from engaging in food production or trading management and from serving as a food safety manager of a food production or trading enterprise.

Where a food producer or trader employs a person who violates the provisions of the preceding two paragraphs, the food safety supervision and administration department of the people's government at or above the county level shall revoke the license.

Article 136 Where a food operator has fulfilled the obligations such as inspection of purchased goods as provided for in this Law, has sufficient evidence to prove that it did not know that the purchased food did not meet the food safety standards, and can truthfully state the source of its purchases, the operator may be exempted from punishment, but the food that does not meet the food safety standards shall be confiscated according to law; if personal injury, property damage, or other harm is caused, the operator shall bear compensation liability according to law.

Article 137 In violation of the provisions of this Law, where a technical institution or technical personnel undertaking food safety risk monitoring and risk assessment work provides false monitoring or assessment information, the directly responsible persons in charge of the technical institution and the technical personnel shall be given the sanction of removal from office or expulsion according to law; if they have a practice qualification, the competent department that granted the qualification shall revoke the practice certificate.

Article 138 In violation of the provisions of this Law, where a food inspection institution or food inspection personnel issues a false inspection report, the competent department or institution that granted its qualification shall revoke the inspection qualification of the food inspection institution, confiscate the inspection fees collected, and impose a fine of not less than five times but not more than ten times the inspection fees; if the inspection fees are less than 10,000 yuan, a fine of not less than 50,000 yuan but not more than 100,000 yuan shall also be imposed; the directly responsible persons in charge of the food inspection institution and the food inspection personnel shall be given the sanction of removal from office or expulsion according to law; if a major food safety accident is caused, the directly responsible persons in charge and the food inspection personnel shall be given the sanction of expulsion.

In violation of the provisions of this Law, a person of a food inspection institution who has been subjected to the sanction of expulsion shall not engage in food inspection work within ten years from the date of the sanction decision; a person of a food inspection institution who has been subjected to criminal punishment for a food safety illegal act, or who has been subjected to the sanction of expulsion for issuing a false inspection report causing a major food safety accident, shall be permanently prohibited from engaging in food inspection work. Where a food inspection institution employs a person who is prohibited from engaging in food inspection work, the competent department or institution that granted its qualification shall revoke the inspection qualification of the food inspection institution.

Where a food inspection institution issues a false inspection report, thereby harming the lawful rights and interests of consumers, it shall bear joint and several liability with the food producer or trader.

Article 139 In violation of the provisions of this Law, where a certification body issues a false certification conclusion, the certification and accreditation supervision and administration department shall confiscate the certification fees collected and impose a fine of not less than five times but not more than ten times the certification fees; if the certification fees are less than 10,000 yuan, a fine of not less than 50,000 yuan but not more than 100,000 yuan shall also be imposed; if the circumstances are serious, the department shall order suspension of business, or even revoke the approval document of the certification body and make it public; the practice qualification of the directly responsible persons in charge and the certification personnel who bear direct responsibility shall be revoked.

Where a certification body issues a false certification conclusion, thereby harming the lawful rights and interests of consumers, it shall bear joint and several liability with the food producer or trader.

Article 140 In violation of the provisions of this Law, where false publicity is made for food in advertisements to deceive consumers, or where an advertisement for health food is published without obtaining an approval document or the content of the advertisement is inconsistent with the approval document, the penalty shall be imposed in accordance with the provisions of the Advertising Law of the People's Republic of China.

Where an advertising operator or publisher designs, produces, or publishes a false food advertisement, thereby harming the lawful rights and interests of consumers, it shall bear joint and several liability with the food producer or trader.

Where a social organization or other organization or individual recommends food to consumers in a false advertisement or other false publicity, thereby harming the lawful rights and interests of consumers, it shall bear joint and several liability with the food producer or trader.

In violation of the provisions of this Law, where the food safety supervision and administration department, among other departments, a food inspection institution, or a food industry association recommends food to consumers by way of advertisements or other forms, or a consumer organization recommends food to consumers by charging fees or seeking other benefits, the relevant competent department shall confiscate the illegal gains, and give the sanction of a major demerit, demotion, or removal from office to the directly responsible persons in charge and other directly liable persons according to law; if the circumstances are serious, the sanction of expulsion shall be given.

Where false publicity is made for food and the circumstances are serious, the food safety supervision and administration department of the people's government at or above the provincial level shall decide to suspend the sale of the food and make it public; if the food is still sold, the food safety supervision and administration department of the people's government at or above the county level shall confiscate the illegal gains and the illegally sold food, and impose a fine of not less than 20,000 yuan but not more than 50,000 yuan.

Article 141 In violation of the provisions of this Law, where a person fabricates or disseminates false food safety information, and the act constitutes a violation of public security administration, the public security organ shall impose a public security administration penalty according to law.

Where a media outlet fabricates or disseminates false food safety information, the relevant competent department shall impose a penalty according to law, and give sanctions to the directly responsible persons in charge and other directly liable persons; if the lawful rights and interests of citizens, legal persons, or other organizations are harmed, the media outlet shall bear civil liability such as eliminating the impact, restoring reputation, compensating for losses, and making a formal apology according to law.

Article 146 Where the food safety supervision and administration department, among other departments, in the course of performing its food safety supervision and administration duties, illegally implements law enforcement measures such as inspection or compulsory measures, thereby causing losses to producers or traders, it shall compensate according to law, and the directly responsible persons in charge and other directly liable persons shall be given sanctions according to law.

Article 147 In violation of the provisions of this Law, where personal injury, property damage, or other harm is caused, the liable party shall bear compensation liability according to law. Where the property of a producer or trader is insufficient to simultaneously bear civil compensation liability and pay fines or penalties, the civil compensation liability shall be borne first.

Article 148 Where a consumer suffers harm due to food that does not meet food safety standards, the consumer may claim compensation for losses from the operator or from the producer. The producer or operator that receives a consumer's compensation claim shall implement the first-liability system, make compensation in advance, and shall not shirk responsibility; if the liability lies with the producer, the operator, after making compensation, has the right to seek recourse from the producer; if the liability lies with the operator, the producer, after making compensation, has the right to seek recourse from the operator.

Where food that does not meet food safety standards is produced, or where an operator knowingly operates food that does not meet food safety standards, in addition to claiming compensation for losses, the consumer may also demand from the producer or operator a payment of ten times the purchase price or three times the losses; if the amount of additional compensation is less than 1,000 yuan, it shall be 1,000 yuan. However, this shall not apply if there are defects in the food labels or instructions that do not affect food safety and do not mislead consumers.
Article 149 In violation of the provisions of this Law, if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 150 For the purposes of this Law, the following terms shall have the meanings as defined below:

Food means any finished product or raw material intended for human consumption or drinking, as well as any article that is traditionally both food and a Chinese medicinal material, but does not include articles intended for therapeutic purposes.

Food safety means that food is non-toxic, harmless, meets the required nutritional standards, and does not cause any acute, subacute, or chronic harm to human health.

Prepackaged food means food that has been pre-quantitatively packaged, or made into packaging materials or containers.

Food additive means any synthetic or natural substance added to food for the purpose of improving food quality, color, aroma, and taste, as well as for the needs of preservation, freshness retention, and processing technology, including nutritional fortifiers.

Packaging materials and containers for food means articles such as paper, bamboo, wood, metal, enamel, ceramics, plastics, rubber, natural fibers, chemical fibers, glass, etc., used for packaging or holding food or food additives, as well as coatings that come into direct contact with food or food additives.

Tools and equipment for food production and trading means machinery, pipelines, conveyor belts, containers, utensils, tableware, etc., that come into direct contact with food or food additives during the production, sale, or use of food or food additives.

Detergents and disinfectants for food means substances directly used for washing or disinfecting food, tableware, drinking vessels, and tools, equipment, or food packaging materials and containers that come into direct contact with food.

Food shelf life means the period during which food maintains its quality under the indicated storage conditions.

Foodborne diseases means infectious, toxic, and other diseases caused by the entry of pathogenic factors in food into the human body, including food poisoning.

Food safety accident means an accident originating from food, such as a foodborne disease or food contamination, that is harmful or may be harmful to human health.
Article 151 Where food safety management of genetically modified food and edible salt is not provided for in this Law, the provisions of other laws and administrative regulations shall apply.

Article 152 Measures for the administration of food safety in railway and civil aviation operations shall be formulated by the food safety supervision and administration department of the State Council jointly with the relevant departments of the State Council in accordance with this Law.
Specific measures for the administration of health foods shall be formulated by the food safety supervision and administration department of the State Council in accordance with this Law.
Specific measures for the administration of production activities of food-related products shall be formulated by the food safety supervision and administration department of the State Council in accordance with this Law.
The supervision and administration of food at frontier ports shall be implemented by the entry-exit inspection and quarantine authorities in accordance with this Law and the provisions of relevant laws and administrative regulations.
Measures for the administration of food safety of military-specific food and self-supplied food shall be formulated by the Central Military Commission in accordance with this Law.
Article 153 The State Council may, based on actual needs, make adjustments to the food safety supervision and management system.
Article 154 This Law shall come into force on October 1, 2015.
